In the 1700–1950 period, this was a routine CoD entry for such cases. Before measles vaccination, pneumonia was the leading fatal complication of measles, making this clinically the most plausible reading.

Pre-imaging-era certifiers could not distinguish ischaemic vs haemorrhagic strokes, so the unspecified stroke code is the standard target.
